$comment: Legitimate hits of the public hygiene check (scripts/public-hygiene.mjs) in files that cannot carry a
'hygiene-allow: <reason>' comment on the same line. Each entry names a "path" (glob: * within a
directory, ** across directories) or a "commit" id, optionally a "rule" and a "line", and always a
"reason". Name the file and the rule; do not repeat the matched text here.
